definitions.side: Native-pixel fixed square head/shoulder proposal side; no upsampling floor or admission gate.
definitions.output_face_height: Median measured face height if the proposed square were resized to 512 pixels; statistics only.
definitions.face_area_in_crop: Median facial-landmark width times height divided by proposed crop area.
definitions.unmeasured: Still included in audio decisions, never treated as a zero-size valid crop.
definitions.head_fit: Landmark-based hair/forehead estimate, not verified full-head segmentation.
definitions.terminal_pools: Superseded parent candidates excluded; accepted children counted once.
